body.title: Add claim, release and the review-fix decision
body.summary: In src/workflow/team/gate.ts add claim(repo, unit) (only an unassigned unit; addAssignee then a re-read; a contested or failed claim is refused and nobody is removed, and the wording says contention is reported when observed) and release(repo, unit) (clears the assignees through setAssignee for the holder or a policy administrator, including a contested claim; anyone else refused with no port write), and reviewFixDecision(repo, unit) returning apply-auto-fixes for the holder or when no gate applies and report-only for a non-holder or a failed read.
acceptanceChecks: claim takes only an unassigned stage and never removes another assignee
A contested claim and a failed re-read are refused; the interleaving where the earlier claimant returned allowed and only the later one observes contention is tested
release clears for the holder and for an administrator and refuses anyone else without calling setAssignee
reviewFixDecision returns report-only for a non-holder and for a failed read
